summary: Frontend-only retest of the 'Gledaj RTV Cazin uživo' fix. MOBILE BUG IS FIXED: at 390x844, opening the mobile menu and clicking rtv-live-mobile closes the menu, and rtv-live-dialog stays open with rtv-live-iframe (src https://crt-stream.loopstudiobih.dev/embed/). It was still open after 5s, and the player showed 'Baferovanje…' (buffering) with its controls. Closing with the X and by clicking the overlay both work, and reopening works over two full rounds. On mobile the dialog is 374px wide and the iframe is 350x196.9 (ratio 1.778 = 16:9), with no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390 = innerWidth). On desktop at 1280 and 1920, rtv-live-button opens the dialog with the iframe (872x490.5, 16:9). Closing with the overlay or the X and reopening work at both sizes. Two minor issues: Escape does not close the dialog, and the X button is almost invisible.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the dialog. Radix auto-focuses the first focusable element, which is the cross-origin iframe (document.activeElement = rtv-live-iframe right after opening), so key events go to the iframe and never reach the dialog.

issues: The default shadcn X close button uses color rgb(11,31,59) at 0.7 opacity on a bg-black dialog, so it is almost invisible. This is a problem on mobile, where the X is the main way to close. Fix: give the close button a white colour (e.g. [&>button]:text-white on DialogContent) and a larger tap area.

action_items: Make the dialog X close button visible on the black background (text-white, opacity-100, larger hit area for mobile)
Optional: add onOpenAutoFocus={(e)=>e.preventDefault()} to DialogContent (or focus the close button) so Escape works and focus does not jump into the iframe
critical_code_review_comments: The event-bus approach (window 'ccn-rtv-open' event + RtvPlayer mounted outside the Sheet) correctly fixes the unmount-on-menu-close bug.
RtvPlayer unmounts on close ('if (!open) return null'). This is fine because it stops the stream, but it skips the Radix close animation. That is acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RTV live feature verified on mobile 390, desktop 1280 and 1920. Only open items: X button contrast and Escape not closing the dialog (focus lands in the iframe).
